channel.title: BOLDr Careers blog
channel.description: Straight answers for a mid-career job search.

item.title: How to write a LinkedIn headline that recruiters find
item.description: Lead with the job you want, add the skills recruiters search, one result and your industry, in 220 characters. The method, then a free tool that builds it from your resume.

item.title: How to research your interviewer before an interview
item.description: Know who you are meeting: who they are, what their company is doing now, and where your experience meets their problem. The method, then a 40-second way to do it.

item.title: Your company is being acquired. What happens to your job?
item.description: Little changes before an acquisition closes. After it, roles that exist on both sides are reviewed first. What it means for you, and your first 30 days.

item.title: How to get your resume past an ATS
item.description: Build your resume once in a layout an ATS reads whole, then match each posting's words. The method step by step, plus two free Word templates.
